page_title: DOR 2-3 RBL | Dortmund v RB Leipzig 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+6' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+3' 2 - 3 Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet a cross the corner kick and scores with a great header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:3.
90+2' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+1' 1 - 3 Goal! Emil Forsberg puts the ball on a plate for Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:3.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 3:7.
84' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
82' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Donyell Malen (Dortmund) replaces Ramy Bensebaini.
82' A substitution has been made. Thomas Meunier goes off and Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) comes on.
82' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) replacing Amadou Haidara.
81' Emre Can (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is replacing Xavi Simons.
75' Here's the change. Lois Openda leaves the pitch and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
75' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Christoph Baumgartner and he is replaced by Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig).
74' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
72' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marco Reus as he is replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
68' Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
60' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
58' Dangerous play by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Wonderful movement by RB Leipzig. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
54' 1 - 2 Goal! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:2.
54' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.

53' A sweet pass finds Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
51' The ball is cleared after Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig).
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+6' 1 - 1 Niklas Sule (Dortmund) meets a perfect cross from Julian Brandt deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
45+6' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+6' The ball is out of play and Dortmund manage to earn a corner. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Janis Blaswich, who pulls off a stunning save!

45+5' Janis Blaswich was forced into action to thwart Thomas Meunier (Dortmund). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
45+3' The shots on goal statistics – 0:2.
45+2' Fine play by David Raum (RB Leipzig) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

39' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Dortmund are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
37' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
35' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
34' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
32' 0 - 1 Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) scores an own goal inside his own right post as he attempts to head the ball away from the corner kick.
31' The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
26' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
24' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
20' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Substitution. Niklas Sule (Dortmund) in, Jamie Bynoe-Gittens out.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
16' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
15' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
15' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Sven Jablonski changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
13' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
13' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
13' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Mats Hummels (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
12' Referee Sven Jablonski sees the trip by Mats Hummels (Dortmund) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from RB Leipzig is about to take a penalty kick.
10' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
